commits_data.title: epan: Rename text-only functions
commits_data.message:
epan: Rename text-only functions

Adds a text node from a user-supplied string:

  proto_tree_add_text() -> proto_tree_add_text_format()
  proto_tree_add_text_wsp() -> proto_tree_add_text_format_wsp()

Adds a text node from the TVbuff contents:

  proto_tree_add_format_text() -> proto_tree_add_text()
  proto_tree_add_format_text_wsp() -> proto_tree_add_text_wsp()

Also add an encoding parameter to proto_tree_add_text(). Almost
everything is set to ENC_ASCII, as that matched the previous behaviour
but in the future it might be improved on a per-protocol basis.

commits_data.title: epan: Refactor proto_tree_add_format_text()
commits_data.message:
epan: Refactor proto_tree_add_format_text()

Fix some naming issues, simplify some code, reduce duplication
and try to be more consistent handling text-only nodes and
formatting text for display in general.
